summary: Verified the new Contract-History Webhook feature on PREVIEW (https://org-manager-lite.preview.emergentagent.com). Backend: 7/7 pytest checks pass — field is accepted in OrgUpdate, invalid non-Discord URLs are rejected 400, valid Discord webhook URLs persist, empty string clears to None, GET /api/user/my-org returns the field. Frontend: MyOrgPanel on /orgs shows the 'Contract-History Webhook (optional)' input with data-testid='org-discord-history-webhook'; filling a valid Discord URL and clicking Save Org Profile fires PUT /api/orgs/{id} (200), shows 'Org saved.' feedback, and the value re-populates on reload. dispatch_completion_history() helper is wired into POST /api/contracts/{id}/complete via asyncio.create_task and is defined without raising on invalid webhook (uses try/except with logger.warning).

issues: Onboarding carousel modal appears on every navigation to /orgs even after prior sessions; it does not persist a 'seen' flag, forcing repeated dismissals. Not blocking the tested feature (Save still worked with force click) but poor UX for returning users.

action_items: No action required for the reported feature — user's complaint 'field is not visible' is confirmed as a PRODUCTION vs PREVIEW mismatch (feature exists in preview code only). Guide user to test on https://org-manager-lite.preview.emergentagent.com, or promote the feature to production.
Optional: persist onboarding carousel dismissal in localStorage so it doesn't re-appear on every /orgs visit.
critical_code_review_comments: Organizations.jsx is 785 lines — consider splitting MyOrgPanel into its own file for maintainability.
dispatch_completion_history runs fire-and-forget via asyncio.create_task — good; failures are logged as warnings and never bubble up to the /complete endpoint (correct pattern).
OrgUpdate.discord_history_webhook_url has no Pydantic-level format validator; validation is in-route (line 3304). Acceptable but could be moved into a Pydantic validator for consistency.
server.py is 5012 lines — should be split into routers per resource.
